assignments.reason: Holy speech (דִּבּוּרִים קְדוֹשִׁים) belongs by essential nature to the domain of the sage of the generation. The source text (line 33) states that the sage (חכם הדור = נמלה) 'מְלַמֵּד דַּעַת וְדַרְכֵי ה׳ אֶל הָעָם' — teaches knowledge and God's ways to the people. Holy speech is the sage's medium of operation, the instrument through which he fulfills his role. Its essential nature is the positive dimension of wisdom-in-action — the sage speaking truth — which is the core identity of Package 3. The causal connection (holy speech produces holy wings) flows BETWEEN packages (from Package 3 to Package 1), but the speech itself is rooted in the sage's identity.

Making holy wings (כְּנָפַיִם דִּקְדֻשָּׁה) belongs by essential nature to the brit/six-wings domain. The source text (line 23) explicitly contrasts these holy wings against the six wings of holiness: 'וְהֵם נֶגֶד הַשֵּׁשׁ כְּנָפַיִם שֶׁל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה הַנַּ"ל' — the evil wings made by evil speech are OPPOSED to the six holy wings. This means the holy wings ARE the six wings of kedusha (שש כנפים), which are already established as a bechina of the six tepachim in Package 1 (line 3: 'שֵׁשׁ כְּנָפַיִם, הֵם בְּחִינַת הַשִּׁשָּׁה טְפָחִים'). The essential nature of holy wings is the cosmic six-dimensional structure of the brit — they are the wings of the seraphim, the six tepachim in their active, flying manifestation. The proof text 'וּבַעַל כְּנָפַיִם יַגֵּיד דָּבָר' (Kohelet 10:20) confirms: the master of wings declares the word — the wings are the brit-structure that carries holy speech.
